description: Look up real H-1B base salaries for a job title from DOL LCA disclosures — a market wage benchmark backed by actual filed salaries (not estimates). Answers 'what do H-1B software engineers earn at company X / in city Y'. Filter by job title, and optionally by employer, city, and year. Returns salary statistics (count, min / median / average / max) plus a sample of individual records (employer, title, salary, location, dates).

city.description: Optional work city, e.g. "SEATTLE" or "NEW YORK".

employer.description: Optional employer name to scope to, e.g. "Meta".

job_title.description: Job title to search, e.g. "software engineer", "data scientist". Matched as a substring of the disclosed title.

limit.description: Max sample records to return (default 15, max 50).

year.description: Filing year (e.g. 2024). Defaults to the most recent full year.

name: h1b_salary
title: H1b Salary
